0b9e546d78acd95d.name: accessibility
0b9e546d78acd95d.says: The website meets WCAG 2.2 level AA. Whether the law requires a standard is asked in Q14.

103c907f0d828f35.name: Staff time stays in hand
103c907f0d828f35.target: reading feedback takes no more than 1 hour of staff time a week

1cfc1936275b5acd.name: Ask after a purchase
1cfc1936275b5acd.statement: When a customer's order has been delivered, the website shall send them one request for feedback holding a link to the feedback page.

1f57eaf676000b93.name: Email before text
1f57eaf676000b93.statement: Where a customer can be reached by both email and text message, the website shall send the request by email.

20dba5fb4f46f564.name: Icons
20dba5fb4f46f564.says: | Rule | Value | |---|---| | The set | drawn for this product: a star, a warning, a tick and the mark's speech bubble | | Size | 20px in a message, 24px in a tick, 36px for a star to pick (40px on a phone), 18px for a star to read | | A word beside it | always: a star has its number, a warning its message |

2345b64edc8e6f0c.name: availability
2345b64edc8e6f0c.says: If the website goes down, it is back within one working day, and no request is lost.

23889567953f42ab.name: Words
23889567953f42ab.says: | Rule | Example | |---|---| | A button says what it does | Send, Stop asking me, Keep it | | A refusal says what is wrong, in plain words | That email address doesn't look right. | | We, the business; you, the customer | We've received your feedback. | | Sentence case everywhere | Monthly figures | | Contractions are fine: the tone is a person talking | We couldn't receive your feedback. |

2417c5a9a463764a.name: Give feedback without an account
2417c5a9a463764a.statement: The website shall let anyone who opens it send feedback without signing in.

2adae0a1faea404b.name: Layout
2adae0a1faea404b.says: | Rule | Value | |---|---| | A customer's page | one card, 560px wide at most, centred on the page | | Staff sign-in | one card, 400px wide at most, centred on the page | | A staff page | 1040px wide at most, centred, with the staff header across the top | | The side margins | 24px; 16px on a phone | | Breakpoint | 640px: under it everything stands in one column, and the staff header's links take a row of their own | | Tap targets | 44px at least on a phone |

2d2defd00c667e4b.name: Business mark
2d2defd00c667e4b.purpose: The business's name, at the top of a page.
2d2defd00c667e4b.rules: A plain speech bubble stands in until the business has a logo.

31ae37c0954938d9.name: Monthly figures
31ae37c0954938d9.purpose: Staff read the numbers behind the goals, month by month.

states.what it shows: No figures yet.
The heading, while the figures arrive.
Could not load, with a way to try again.
Signed out, the address leads to SC5, and no figures show.

Tab reaches the header, then each button in order; the focus always shows.
At 375 pixels everything stands in one column at full width; a table scrolls on its own.
Back leaves the page; the address opens it as it stands now.
Only signed-in staff.

31e0e9359b44dfdd.name: Keep every piece of feedback
31e0e9359b44dfdd.statement: When a person sends feedback, the website shall keep it with the date and time it arrived.

36cdffd528c6d268.name: Delete after 12 months
36cdffd528c6d268.statement: When a piece of feedback is 12 months old, the website shall delete it and the email address kept with it.

3c8ecea73c225b3a.name: languages
3c8ecea73c225b3a.says: The website, its emails and its text messages are in English only, and its days and months run in the business's local time.

42a2b5f4b61f1b7c.name: Checkbox
42a2b5f4b61f1b7c.purpose: One yes or no, off until the person turns it on.
42a2b5f4b61f1b7c.rules: Never ticked for the person. Its words say what ticking it means.

445dc99b56c5440b.name: Feedback card
445dc99b56c5440b.purpose: One piece of feedback in the staff's list.
445dc99b56c5440b.rules: What a customer left out is left out of the card. Unhappy feedback has a red edge as well as its tag.

4599275cb1a3cc51.measured by: the business's review scores on public review sites and marketplaces
4599275cb1a3cc51.name: Public review scores do not fall
4599275cb1a3cc51.target: the public review scores do not fall from their level at launch

4a6c3ccc467cbf4c.name: Remove this feedback
4a6c3ccc467cbf4c.purpose: Staff confirm before a piece of feedback is removed.

states.what it shows: Remove cannot be pressed again.
Could not be removed; the feedback stays.
Its buttons mark themselves under the pointer; a touch screen has nothing in its place.
The focus starts on Keep it and stays in the dialog; Escape keeps the feedback.
At 375 pixels the dialog fills the width.
It has no address of its own; a reload shows the list.
Only signed-in staff.

transitions.event: Keep it is pressed, or Escape

4f633f9b43134415.name: speed
4f633f9b43134415.says: On a phone, the feedback page opens within 5 seconds, and Send finishes within 5 seconds.

563a9b7ebc1513d1.name: Unhappy feedback stands out
563a9b7ebc1513d1.statement: When feedback rated 1 or 2 stars arrives, the website shall mark it in the staff's list.

629b1bc8776a7d25.says: The first release may take up to 3 months.

63ed0ca46d6f47ff.name: Satisfaction by month
63ed0ca46d6f47ff.statement: The website shall show staff the average rating of each calendar month.

6ad64ddf5084ab1a.name: The request by email
6ad64ddf5084ab1a.purpose: A customer who bought is asked for feedback by email.
6ad64ddf5084ab1a.reached by: sent when an order is delivered

n/a: their own program decides that.

6af8479d9ccc850d.measured by: pieces of feedback received per month
6af8479d9ccc850d.name: Know what to improve
6af8479d9ccc850d.target: 50 pieces of feedback a month, 3 months after launch

6bfeb71e9a96ee0e.question: What is the business's name, and is there a logo?
6bfeb71e9a96ee0e.why: The screens say [Business name], with a plain mark, until this is known.

6c3a334ef684418e.name: Text
6c3a334ef684418e.says: Typeface: Inter, then Segoe UI, then the system's own sans-serif. Inter comes from Google Fonts; offline, the next one stands in. | Used for | Size, weight and line height | Sample | |---|---|---| | A screen's title | Inter, 28px, 600, on 34px; 24px on 30px on a phone | How did we do? | | A section's title | Inter, 20px, 600, on 28px | Who opted out | | Body text and fields | Inter, 16px, 400, on 24px | The delivery was late | | Buttons | Inter, 15px, 600, on 22px | Send | | Labels | Inter, 14px, 500, on 20px | Your rating | | Hints, dates and notes | Inter, 14px, 400, on 20px, muted | 3 March, 14:05 | | Tags and table heads | Inter, 13px, 500, on 18px | Not for publishing |

6c9e23774b4989c2.name: security
6c9e23774b4989c2.says: The website uses an encrypted connection, never stores a password in readable form, and blocks repeated failed sign-ins. Only signed-in staff can see or remove feedback.

73aa8c0c78a73640.name: When delivery cannot be known
73aa8c0c78a73640.statement: If the delivery of an order cannot be known, then the website shall send the request 7 days after the order was placed.

748a5f07c0182636.name: Email staff about an unhappy user
748a5f07c0182636.statement: When feedback rated 1 or 2 stars arrives, the website shall email every member of staff.

7f9cd23a9da78204.name: An email address for a reply
7f9cd23a9da78204.statement: Where a person gives an email address, the website shall keep it with their feedback.

8204b4715d7b4693.measured by: complaints and opt-outs from the requests for feedback
8204b4715d7b4693.name: Customers do not feel pestered
8204b4715d7b4693.target: opt-outs and complaints stay at or below 1% of requests sent

82daaf72c17cef91.name: Feedback per month
82daaf72c17cef91.statement: The website shall show staff how many pieces of feedback arrived in each calendar month, leaving out those they removed.

880f1e4a86abc32a.name: proof
880f1e4a86abc32a.says: The website can show the date of each opt-out and each permission to publish, for as long as each applies.

8ce200efe9bc658a.name: Button
8ce200efe9bc658a.purpose: What a person presses: to send, to sign in, to confirm or to keep.
8ce200efe9bc658a.rules: One primary button on a screen at most. It says what it does. Danger is only for what cannot be undone, and always beside a way to keep it. The quiet danger button is for Remove in a list.

variants.when: the one main action of a screen
an action beside the main one
starting something that cannot be undone, from a list
it has been pressed, and cannot be pressed again

90849169c8349c05.name: Message
90849169c8349c05.purpose: Says that something was refused or failed, where it can be seen.
90849169c8349c05.rules: Above what it is about. Says what is wrong and what to do. Announced to a screen reader when it appears.

9b1ee8ad7df1ac31.name: Star rating
9b1ee8ad7df1ac31.purpose: The five stars a customer picks from, and staff and emails read back.
9b1ee8ad7df1ac31.rules: One to five stars and nothing else. The number is always written beside the stars, so that a rating is never shown by the stars alone.

variants.when: the customer has not picked yet, or has picked no rating
the customer has picked a number of stars
staff read a rating; it cannot be changed
the pointer is over a star
the focus is on the stars

9e23da5f7ef4794a.name: Remove feedback
9e23da5f7ef4794a.statement: When a member of staff removes a piece of feedback, the website shall take it out of the list and the monthly figures.

a0bf38729f5f1875.name: Opting out of requests
a0bf38729f5f1875.statement: When a customer opts out, the website shall send them no more requests for feedback.

a2029f5b45a70538.measured by: pieces of feedback received per month
a2029f5b45a70538.name: Track satisfaction
a2029f5b45a70538.target: 50 pieces of feedback a month, 3 months after launch

a919c444502a5f67.reached by: sent when feedback rated 1 or 2 stars arrives

Try again | | What cannot be undone | A dialog says what will go, with a danger C3 that does it and a secondary C3 that keeps it; the focus starts on the one that keeps it. | Remove this feedback? | | Nothing to show | A sentence in a dashed box. | No feedback yet. | | Done | A tick, a title that says so, and a line. | Thank you | | Dates and times | The day, the month in words; the time on 24 hours. | 3 March, 14:05 | | A rating | The stars and the number together, always. | 2 of 5 |

b6304b506643707a.name: Only staff read feedback
b6304b506643707a.statement: The website shall show feedback only to staff who have signed in.

ba62a3e5d2c89240.name: Permission to publish
ba62a3e5d2c89240.statement: The website shall let a person say that the business may publish what they wrote.

ba71aa59a4429c76.says: The website's server side is written in Python.

bce486e318733220.name: Accessibility
bce486e318733220.says: | Rule | Value | |---|---| | The standard | WCAG 2.2 level AA (Y6) | | Contrast | every pair of text and ground at 4.5:1 or more, and a star and a control's edge at 3:1 or more on white | | Focus | a 2px ring in the accent, #2456C8, 2px off the element, on every link, button and field | | Keyboard | Tab reaches every control in reading order; the stars are one group of radio buttons, moved through with the arrow keys | | A screen reader | C6 is an alert, announced when it appears; a rating is read as its number out of 5 | | Colour | never alone: Unhappy says its word, and a rating its number |

be2f9395e66a9fd6.rules: Its words carry the meaning: the colour only supports them. Never pressed.

bf681e986c16cc96.answers: whoever looks after legal or data protection
bf681e986c16cc96.question: May the business use customers' email addresses and mobile numbers to ask for feedback, and what must it do to comply?
bf681e986c16cc96.why: Whoever looks after legal or data protection could stop the requests, and what the law requires is not the specification's to assume.

c5cb9017754616cb.name: devices
c5cb9017754616cb.says: The website works in current browsers on phones and computers.

c6695beda2d4c09d.name: Requests and opt-outs per month
c6695beda2d4c09d.statement: The website shall show staff how many requests were sent and how many customers opted out in each calendar month.

c7fd5a3bd10f8e90.name: A record of opt-outs and permissions
c7fd5a3bd10f8e90.statement: The website shall keep the date of every opt-out and of every permission to publish.

cf1fc6a14d9e3cb7.measured by: pieces of feedback received per month
cf1fc6a14d9e3cb7.name: Collect testimonials
cf1fc6a14d9e3cb7.target: 50 pieces of feedback a month, 3 months after launch

d3bf0e924b594dda.statement: The website shall show the business's staff every piece of feedback they have not removed, newest first.

d5ddf3fb2b01c8b6.name: At most one request a month
d5ddf3fb2b01c8b6.statement: While a customer has received a request in the past month, the website shall send them no other request.

d677caeeb30bc515.name: A rating with the feedback
d677caeeb30bc515.statement: The website shall let a person give a rating of 1 to 5 stars with their feedback.

da58615e74cbdece.question: After how many failed sign-ins is someone refused, and for how long?
